caption:
🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

Without Albert Einstein, Google Maps would be unusable within hours!

Here is why:
🔹 Satellite atomic clocks tick 38 microseconds faster each day due to relativity.
🔹 Radio signals travel at the speed of light: 300,000 km/s.
🔹 38 microseconds translates into an 11 km navigation drift every single day!
